title: aidd test runners
description: The format of schemas/test-runners.json: what aidd knows about each test runner. A new runner is a row and no code. A row gives the exits the runner's own documentation says no test failed in, so `aidd test` does not take a red run that ended with one for proof of new behavior. A row may also give what the runner's documentation says of a mode that runs only the tests related to changed files, which `aidd test --changed` suggests as a test command's `related_tests`. A row with neither says only that aidd knows the runner by name.

runners.description: One row for each runner, keyed by the name a command shows it by, such as `go test`, in the order `aidd init` lists the runners it finds.

command_words.description: The words that show a command runs this runner: a word of the command whose last path part, in lower case and without `.exe`, is one of these. Needed when the row has `not_red_exits` or `related_tests.arguments`.

not_red_exits.description: The exits the runner's documentation gives for a run in which no test failed, by exit. Left out: an exit the documentation does not give, which stays a real failure.

note.description: An exit this row leaves out on purpose, and why.

checked.description: The day a person or an agent read the sources and found the row's exits true.

sources.description: The runner's own documentation that gives each exit, as pages. Needed when the row has `not_red_exits`.

related_tests.description: What the runner's own documentation says of running only the tests related to changed files. With `arguments`, the mode aidd suggests; without, there is none aidd can suggest, and `means` says why.

arguments.description: The words that follow the runner's word in the mode, with `{changed_paths}` where the changed files go, such as `[--passWithNoTests, --findRelatedTests, "{changed_paths}"]`. aidd suggests the command up to the runner's word with these after it, and never writes it.

means.description: What the documentation says the mode does, or that the runner has none built in, and why aidd suggests what it does.

checked.description: The day a person or an agent read the sources and found `related_tests` true.

sources.description: The runner's own documentation the facts come from, as pages.

exit.description: The exit status. 0 is the only pass, 126 and 127 mean the command did not start, and neither is a row.

means.description: What the runner's documentation says the exit means.
